players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Placed on 10-day IL May 14 with right oblique strain — first IL stint of his six-year career. Mariners have given no return timeline.

sources.title: Cal Raleigh placed on IL with oblique strain

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Went 4-for-5 with a 2-RBI single in the 9th to help Phillies erase a 6-run deficit and win 11-9 in 10 innings. Harper was Philadelphia's clutch catalyst in a memorable comeback.

sources.title: Phillies erase 6-run deficit, down Pirates in 10

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Went 4-for-5 with his first home run of 2026 (solo in 4th off Civale) and came within a triple of the cycle. A bright spot in the Giants' 5-2 loss to the Athletics.

sources.title: Luis Arraez's four-hit night, first homer of 2026

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Went 0-for-4 as Cam Schlittler dominated (9 K over 6.2 IP) in a 5-2 Yankees win. Bichette's prolonged 2026 slump is generating trade speculation with his .226 average.

sources.title: Bo Bichette contract and slump put Mets trade talk in focus

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle walked and scored on a wild pitch in the 3rd inning of Detroit's 3-2 win over Toronto. The 21-year-old rookie continues a strong MLB debut, batting over .300.

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: Contributed 2 RBI in the Cubs' 10-5 Crosstown Classic win over the White Sox. PCA has rebounded with strong play over his last 15 games after a slow start to 2026.

sources.title: Enhanced Box Score: Cubs 10, White Sox 5

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Went hitless in the Padres' efficient 2-0 win at Seattle. Randy Vasquez threw six shutout innings; Merrill has been streaky in 2026 after his outstanding 2024 rookie season.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Set to begin a rehab assignment with Single-A Rancho Cucamonga on May 16, with potential activation as early as May 18. Has been on the 10-day IL since May 6 with a Grade 1 left groin strain.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernandez set for rehab assignment

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Did not pitch as the Mets fell 5-2 to the Yankees. Williams has been excellent recently with six consecutive scoreless outings entering the Subway Series.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Not scheduled on May 15; Aaron Nola pitched the Phillies' 11-9 comeback win. Wheeler has a 2.25 ERA through five starts since his April 25 debut following shoulder surgery.

sources.title: Can Zack Wheeler sustain his strong 2026 start?

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Remains on 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with valgus extension overload in his left elbow. Royals expect a minimal IL stay but no firm return date has been announced.

sources.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL With Elbow Impingement

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Did not pitch May 15 after firing 6 shutout innings in the Reds' 15-1 rout of Washington on May 14. Burns remains one of baseball's elite young arms with a 2.05 ERA.

sources.title: How Chase Burns has dominated in 2026

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Day-to-day after being scratched May 12 with left side tightness. Threw a bullpen and is expected to return to the rotation around May 17 in Houston.

sources.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi shares crucial injury update

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Did not pitch May 15 after his best start of 2026 (6 IP, 2 H, 2 ER, 6 K) in the Dodgers' 5-2 win at San Francisco on May 14. Dave Roberts called it his best outing of the year.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan shows growth in Dodgers win

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Did not start May 15; Jack Kochanowicz started for the Angels and allowed 6 runs in the Dodgers' 6-0 shutout win. Detmers continues to work through the LAA rotation.

sources.title: Dodgers vs. Angels box score — May 15, 2026

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went 3-for-4 with his 14th homer of 2026 and scored twice in the Yankees' 5-2 Subway Series opener at Citi Field. Batting .338, he is one of the AL's hottest hitters.

sources.title: Yankees vs. Mets recap: Ben Rice homer, Schlittler dominates

injuries.name: Cal Raleigh
injuries.note: Placed on IL May 14. First IL stint of his six-year career. No return timeline given.

source.title: Cal Raleigh placed on IL with oblique strain

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Grade 1 abductor strain. Rehab at Single-A Rancho Cucamonga begins May 16; potential activation May 18.

source.title: Teoscar Hernandez set for rehab assignment

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Placed retroactive to May 7 with VEO (pitcher's elbow). Return TBD; Royals hopeful for short stay.

source.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Scratched from May 12 start; threw bullpen, expected to return to rotation ~May 17.
